quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Mining & Smelting press release: Regarding Certain Media Reports and Other Information (06-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Responding to media reports and market rumors, particularly in Asia, that competition is intensifying due to the entry of a Korean company and that its copper foil will no longer be used as glass substrates are adopted, Mitsui Kinzoku states some of these reports contain inaccurate information and that there has been no material change in the business environment or the medium- to long-term growth outlook for its copper foil business. The company continues to see medium- to long-term growth potential for VSP(TM), its electro-deposited copper foil for high-frequency circuit boards, and MicroThin(TM), its ultra-thin copper foil, and has begun considering additional investment to further expand production capacity.
